answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an agent joins only after trading with 12 distinct counterparties, each on a public atlas. A newcomer stakes 40 POA of timber for the record, burned if faked. A sybil swarm trading only inside its own canyon of fake accounts shows on the atlas as a closed loop, which auditors reject. Faking 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 POA, far above the 25 POA reward; an honest agent pays once, keeps its stake.
